subject: Competitive bake-off recap + next steps (PulseHealth)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Thompson <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap + next steps (PulseHealth)

Hi Emily —

Thanks for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call to make sure we're aligned and to capture the decision criteria you shared:

Pain points you stated
- Latency spikes on nightly batch processing for generate-heavy flows (up to 800ms tail).
- Cost unpredictability due to bursty traffic patterns across regions.
- Need for fine-grained audit logs and on-prem options for PH-Prod.

Goals for the next 90 days
- Reduce tail latency to < 250ms for 95th percentile on the key routes.
- Demonstrate ~30% lower per-token cost vs current cloud setup under the sample workload.
- Produce evidence for SOC2/KMS integration and audit-log retention policies.

Decision criteria you listed
1) Performance (latency p95/p99 under load)
2) Predictable pricing & cost transparency (reporting & quotas)
3) Security & deployment options (private VPC / on-prem)
4) Integration effort & support SLAs

Competitive landscape you're running
- Vendor A: managed endpoint, strong model zoo but limited private deployment.
- Vendor B: self-hosted runtime, higher ops burden.
- Redwood (us): Dedicated + Private options, runtime optimizations, and built-in tooling for cost/perf.

Open questions / risks we heard
- Which model family do you want us to benchmark? (you mentioned a fine-tuned T5/decoder blend)
- Will you be able to share a representative prompt set and workload trace for the 2-week POC?
- Procurement timeline: looks like your procurement wants vendor selection by end of September.

Proposed next steps
1) We'll share an evaluation matrix (attached) with test vectors and metrics we'll collect.
2) Please share the representative prompt set and a 48–72 hr trace (anonymized) — we can sign an NDA or use a secure upload.
3) Redwood will run a 2-week bake-off with:
   - Baseline (your current infra)
   - Redwood Dedicated (quantized + batching)
   - Redwood Private (if you want on-prem test)
4) Schedule a technical kickoff for Sept 13th — intending 30–45 minutes with Aditya and Logan.

Attachments: pulse_eval_matrix.xlsx (evaluation matrix), redwood_proposal_v1.pdf (baseline pricing + scope)

If that all looks right, can you confirm the prompt set and whether the 13th works for a kickoff?

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0142
From: Emily Thompson <emily@pulsehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun@pulsehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap + next steps (PulseHealth)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap — this is perfect and captures everything we discussed. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Model: we want to test your best-in-class 7B decoder variant and also our tuned T5-small baseline. If Redwood can also show an LLM with quantization enabled that'd be great to include.
- Prompt set & trace: I'll upload an anonymized 72-hr trace and the curated prompt set to the secure bucket by EOD on Friday (Sept 10).
- Procurement: yes, we're aiming to shortlist vendors by Sept 30, and procurement will need an initial SOW + estimated MRC.

Sept 13th kickoff at 10:00am PT works for our engineers. I'll invite Arjun (infra) and Priya (security) — they'll have a few targeted questions on KMS integration.

Also attaching our RFP checklist separately (sending via secure upload).

Best,
Emily
Head of Platform Engineering | PulseHealth
emily@pulsehealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0199
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Emily Thompson <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap + next steps (PulseHealth)

Thanks Emily — looking forward to the kickoff. A few technical notes / asks so we can scope the benchmarks: 

> From Marissa: "Will you be able to share a representative prompt set and workload trace for the 2-week POC?"

- For the bake-off we'll run: latency p50/p95/p99, throughput under concurrency, peak memory, and per-token cost. Please confirm if you also want quality-oriented metrics (e.g., exact-match on key extraction tasks).
- Can you indicate the max sequence lengths and typical batch sizes? That'll drive kernel & batching config.
- Security: for KMS/HSM integration we'll need the KMS admin contact and any IP allowlists for the Private deployment.

We'll prepare two test harnesses: 1) synthetic load matching the trace, 2) exact prompt replay using the prompt set. We'll post results to the shared drive and a short dashboard for quick comparison.

Logan — I'll need a quick pass at the quantization profile and the GPU config we plan to propose for the Dedicated run so we can include it in the proposal.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Staff ML Engineer, Inference 
aditya@redwood.inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Thompson <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap + next steps (PulseHealth)

Emily —

All noted. Thanks for confirming the 13th kickoff at 10:00am PT. I'll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a link to the shared Drive where Aditya will drop the test harness and results dashboard.

Action items owners & timeline
- PulseHealth: upload anonymized trace + prompt set (Emily) — due Sept 10 EOD
- Redwood: kickoff + run 2-week bake-off (Marissa / Aditya / Logan) — start Sept 13, results by Sept 27
- Procurement: initial SOW & estimated MRC (Marissa) — deliver by Sept 20

If anything changes on timing please flag, otherwise we'll proceed as above. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
—Marissa
